_theme_comment: Hero's real brand, confirmed on the live site 2026-08-27: navy #0a2342 header, blue #16407a, red CTA #b22234. Their stylesheet's variable NAMES say teal/amber/green and are misleading -- the hex values that actually render are navy/blue/red. Dark mode lifts the red to #e2586a so it stays legible on a dark ground.

_outreachPreview_comment: The pending B2B referral email program, surfaced for Nash's review BEFORE anything sends. Templates and queue are read off the real program files at build time; emails are masked and internal score columns dropped in build.py. No pricing, trailer-size, or resale language may ever appear here.

outreachPreview.banner: This lane is built and ready. Sending starts on your go-ahead.
outreachPreview.intro: We built a program that introduces Hero's Junk Removal to local businesses that regularly need junk hauled: realtors, property managers, apartment communities, estate sale companies, remodelers, and storage facilities. Every email it would send, and every business it would go to, is laid out below so you can read it all before a single one goes out.
plan: Starts at 15 emails a day and ramps gradually to 40 a day.
Weekday business hours only. Nothing on nights or weekends.
Every email is signed by you and includes a simple opt-out; anyone who says no thanks is never emailed again.
One short follow-up a few days later, then we stop unless they reply.
outreachPreview.templates_note: The name, company, and city fields fill in per recipient. What you read here is otherwise exactly what would be sent.
outreachPreview.queue_note: Local businesses we researched that regularly hire junk haulers. Each would get the intro email for its type, and one follow-up.
